detail: Transit/parking status: Check needed (synthetic fixture whose missing_source_ref is null).
missing_source: DCP Transit Zones (NYC Open Data), the dataset PLUTO's transitzone field is sourced from; recorded in research, no registered connector in this repository
_expected_failure: status 'check_needed' with missing_source_ref null: a check_needed status must carry the structured Source-disclosure object (object, not null), so the allOf/oneOf 'status, status_label, transit_zone, missing_source and missing_source_ref move together' rejects it at the root. Everything else is a valid check_needed document, so the only defect is the null reference.
